summary: This report responds to City Council's request for the City Manager, in consultation with the City Solicitor, to report to the Executive Committee by June 1, 2021 on the impacts of the closure of local court houses, such report to include how the court amalgamation will impact local businesses and access to justice for those living with disabilities.
decided: The Executive Committee: 1. Requested the City Manager to explore with the Province the feasibility of retaining neighbourhood court houses due to their local economic and social importance.
text: This report responds to City Council's request for the City Manager, in consultation with the City Solicitor, to report to the Executive Committee by June 1, 2021 on the impacts of the closure of local court houses, such report to include how the court amalgamation will impact local businesses and access to justice for those living with disabilities.
The Executive Committee: 1. Requested the City Manager to explore with the Province the feasibility of retaining neighbourhood court houses due to their local economic and social importance.
